title: pebbles reindex: rebuild index.json from the issue files
description:
Multi-agent use merges .pebbles branches whose index.json conflicts on every command (verified: any command then fails with 'Failed to parse index file', no repair exists; uc-0f6f1445 doctor only detects). Regenerating the index from issues/*.json is the sanctioned repair and makes per-workspace pebbles copies mergeable.

Ask: `pebbles reindex` rebuilds index.json from the issue files (union of entries, order preserved from the current index when parseable, deterministic otherwise), writes atomically, reports unparsable files and duplicate ids, and verifies with a load. Related: des-b931c524 (write serialization). Reference implementation: the crew skill's regenerate_index (~/.prime/agent/skills/crew).
